content: Postgres INSERT ON CONFLICT only resolves against one named constraint per statement -- there is no native 'try external_id, else email' fallback in a single upsert. PG15+ MERGE gives more conditional flexibility but still needs explicit branching. Standard practice for prioritized-key upsert is application-level: SELECT by primary key first inside a transaction, branch to UPDATE or INSERT ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE as the second attempt.
